description: BHUBANESWAR: In a major push to strengthen its digital and technological ecosystem, the Odisha government is set to establish an Artificial Intelligence (AI) school in the State in the near future.
body_lead: The proposed AI school is part of Odisha’s broader vision to develop a secure, ethical, and responsible artificial intelligence ecosystem: Reports BHUBANESWAR: In a major push to strengthen its digital and technological ecosystem, the Odisha government is set to establish an Artificial Intelligence (AI) school in the State in the near future. The initiative will be formalised through a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU), which the state government is expected to sign shortly.
